name: α,N,N,O-TeMS
summary: α,N,N,O-Tetramethylserotonin (α,N,N,O-TeMS), also known as 5-methoxy-α,N,N-trimethyltryptamine (5-MeO-α,N,N-TMT), is a synthetic compound of the tryptamine, α-alkyltryptamine, and 5-methoxytryptamine families. It is the combined derivative of α-methyltryptamine (αMT) and 5-methoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine (5-MeO-DMT).

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Tryptamine psychedelics as a group can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, a faster heart rate and frightening experiences, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in vulnerable people.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。色胺類迷幻藥整體而言可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳加快和驚恐的經驗，也可能在較脆弱的人身上誘發持久的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。色胺类迷幻药整体而言可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳加快和惊恐的经验，也可能在较脆弱的人身上诱发持久的精神健康问题。

fact.en: It combines two well-known tryptamines in one molecule: the alpha-methyl group of αMT and the 5-methoxy and two N-methyl groups of 5-MeO-DMT.
fact.zh: 它把兩種知名色胺結合在一個分子中：αMT 的 α-甲基，以及 5-MeO-DMT 的 5-甲氧基和兩個 N-甲基。
fact.zhHans: 它把两种知名色胺结合在一个分子中：αMT 的 α-甲基，以及 5-MeO-DMT 的 5-甲氧基和两个 N-甲基。
